Container.Name: hearth
Container.Overview: Hearth is a DIY family wall calendar for a touchscreen: shared calendar with Google/iCloud/Outlook calendars, chore chart, lists, meal planner and pantry recipes. Everything is set up inside the app. Data is stored in MariaDB/MySQL, or in the Data folder if no database is set.

Config.Name: Web page port
Config.Description: Open Hearth at http://your-server:this-port. Change it if another app already uses it.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: So calendar times are right, e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: Your Unraid server's IP if you use MariaDB (e.g. 192.168.1.10). Leave empty to store data in the Data folder instead.

Config.Name: Database password for Hearth
Config.Description: Make up a password. Hearth creates its own database user with it.

Config.Name: MariaDB root password (first start only)
Config.Description: Lets Hearth create its database on the first start. Clear this field once the log says 'created database'.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Only used when no database is set.
